title: Scoping, architecture and real data acquisition
summary: Fixed the project scope, chose two real battery-ageing datasets (NASA PCoE and CALCE CS2), designed the layered system architecture and set up the repository.

title: Data ingestion and quality checks
summary: Built loaders for NASA .mat and CALCE Excel files into one validated table: 4,631 cycles from 8 cells.

title: Data cleaning and health indicators
summary: A one-sided Hampel filter removed 120 interrupted cycles while keeping real capacity regeneration; charge-curve health indicators correlate up to r = 1.00 with SOH.

title: State-of-health estimation models
summary: Five models compared on cells never seen in training. SOH error 2.20% (NASA, Gradient Boosting) and 0.81% (CALCE, Gaussian Process), with 95% intervals covering 95-98% of true values.

title: Remaining useful life prediction
summary: Quantile Gradient Boosting predicts cycles left to 80% SOH within 8.2 cycles (NASA) and 46.6 cycles (CALCE); calibrated bands now cover 76-84% at an 80% target.

title: Second-life grading, application matching and value
summary: Uncertainty-aware grader agrees with lab-truth grades in 83.2% of 101 decisions (89.5% when confident) and flags 65% of its own mistakes for a lab test.

title: Digital Battery Passport
summary: Built a tamper-evident passport: every event is SHA-256 chained and Ed25519 signed. 8 passports with 164 events verify; all 5 tested attacks are detected.
